title: Install experience: first-run workspace and upstream update flow
summary: The exact ask was to make a single-command install register the user's checkout as an editable workspace, check for upstream changes on start, and offer an Update action that opens a readable #upstream merge thread. Bootstrap and fetch/update code are implemented in 0914a8b and that commit is an ancestor of current HEAD. The HTTPS submodule fix is also integrated: current HEAD has the HTTPS URL and ff0702f is an ancestor. However neither parent Task's full done criteria is met: both remain in_progress, the install trial and update/restart flow are outstanding, and current follow-up records still leave the runtime popup unverified and bootstrap rename/Home work pending. Therefore implementation is partial, integration is confirmed for these commits, but verification and release are incomplete.
nextAction: Product Development Lead to coordinate existing bootstrap rename and Home follow-ups with Development Lead; Release Engineer to complete todo_b4d7809f's exact-commit temporary-state fresh-install/update trial after implementation is ready. Do not close either parent Task until the acceptance criteria and runtime/screenshot evidence are met.
